definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating plural, used with people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧{達|たち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んで→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧{達|たち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had a meal with the teachers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧{達|たち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}して→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。

⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{達|たち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The students are listening to the teacher in the classroom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧{達|たち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: They were taking a walk with the dog in the park.

notes:
{達|たち} marks a group of people: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち "the children," ⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧ "we." It is usually written in hiragana.

USAGE:
- Attaches directly to nouns and pronouns: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち, ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}たち→彼女たち：23330_kanojotachi⟧
- Can mean "X and the others": ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さんたち (Tanaka and the others)
- Common with pets and animals in casual speech (⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧たち, ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧たち) and with things in personified or poetic language; not used for ordinary objects
- ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧ is felt as singular today, so ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧たち is heard in speech, though some consider it redundant

REGISTER:
- たち: neutral, everyday
- {方|がた}: honorific (⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧{方|がた}, ⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧{方|がた})
- ら: neutral in ⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧ and in writing (⟦これら→これら：02814_korera⟧); casual or rough with other nouns (⟦{俺|おれ}→俺：02185_ore⟧ら, {奴|やつ}ら)

WATCH OUT:
Japanese nouns need no plural marker. Use たち only when the group matters: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧ can already mean "students came."
